description: List the extra records a purchase order is linked to for reference: each row has exactly one of work_order_id, pm_schedule_id or project_id. Links never add to committed cost; the PO is charged only to its own project_id / work_order_id. Filter by any of those four IDs.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

pm_schedule_id.description: Filter by linked PM schedule ID

work_order_id.description: Filter by linked work order ID

name: list_purchase_order_links
title: List purchase order links
